what_happened: On a straight multi-lane highway at about 5–6 m/s, the ego's plan bent left away from the recorded path and it drifted into the lane on its left, ending about 2.1 m off the human's trajectory. Vehicle 7 was coming up in that lane from behind-left, and by 12.2 s the ego's front corner had cut into it alongside, which counts as an at-fault front collision.

The ego was going straight in its highway lane at about 8.5 m/s and stayed within 0.6 m of the recorded path. A car coming up from behind in the right lane (actor 24) moved alongside and angled into the ego's front-right corner at 9.2 s. The ego was about 20 m behind where the real car was at that moment, so the replayed car likely merged into space that was empty in the original drive; the camera smear at impact is just the close-range actor.

The ego was going straight and staying in its lane at about 8.5 m/s, but it was about 19 m behind where the recorded human car was. Actor 24 came up from behind in the lane to the right, passed alongside and drifted left over the lane line, clipping the ego's front-right corner at 9.2s; the replayed actor never reacted to the ego.

On a straight freeway with the STRAIGHT command, the ego slowed gradually from 8.7 to 7.8 m/s while its planned path bent right toward the right lane line. Actor 24 was overtaking in the adjacent right lane, and the ego's front-right corner clipped it as the ego drifted about 0.5 m right of the recorded path, which counted as an at-fault front collision.

The ego was told to go RIGHT and the recorded route continued straight or bore right. Instead, the policy's planned path drifted left: it slowed behind lead car 48 and moved over the left lane line, ending up 1.8 m off the recorded path. Actor 7 was coming up in the left lane, and the ego's left side hit it at 8.2 s (lateral collision).

The ego was driving straight in its lane on a highway at about 8 m/s, slowing a little, and stayed within 0.6 m of the recorded path. Actor 24 came up from behind on the right and moved left into the ego's lane, hitting the ego's right-front side (rear contact was also flagged). The ego was about 20 m behind where the human driver was at that moment, so the replayed actor merged into space the ego now occupied; the ego made no lateral move into the actor.

On a multi-lane highway, the policy steered left toward the adjacent lane, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT and the recorded path stayed in lane. Its front corner hit vehicle 41, which was travelling alongside in that left lane.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego slowed from 7.9 to 5.0 m/s and drifted left out of its lane, away from the recorded path and opposite to the RIGHT route command. It moved into the adjacent left lane and its front clipped actor 41, which was travelling alongside there. The car is clearly visible at the left edge of the camera view at impact.

Behind slow lead car 48, the ego drifted left out of its lane at about 3–4 m/s, even though the route command was RIGHT and the recorded path stayed in the lane. It moved into the lane of actor 7, which was coming up from behind on the left, and the two collided side-on at 8.2 s.

The ego was holding its lane at about 8 m/s on a straight multi-lane road. Actor 24 came up from behind in the lane to the right, drew level with the ego, then moved left across the lane line into the ego's front-right corner at 9.2 s. The ego followed the recorded path closely (0.6 m) but was about 20 m behind where the human driver was at that point, so the logged merge of actor 24 landed on the ego instead of behind it.

The ego was cruising straight in its lane at about 8.5 m/s, staying within 0.6 m of the recorded path, while lead car 14 pulled away ahead. Actor 24 came up from behind on the right and drifted over the lane line into the ego's right-front side, a likely cut-in. The ego was about 19 m behind where the recorded car was at that time, so the replayed actor merged into space the original car had already left.

On a wet multi-lane freeway with the command STRAIGHT (RIGHT in the last frame), the policy's planned path curved left and the ego drifted from its lane toward the left lane, while the recorded human path stayed straight. Its left side hit actor 41, which was traveling alongside in that left lane (a lateral collision at 7.2s).

On a multi-lane freeway, the ego slowed behind lead car 48. Its planned path then bent left, away from the recorded route and against the RIGHT command, and the ego moved onto the lane line on its left. At 8.2s its left side hit actor 7, which was coming up alongside in the left lane (lateral collision, ego 1.7 m off the recorded path).

The ego was going straight on a highway at about 8 m/s, slower than the recorded drive, and fell nearly 20 m behind where the human car was. Actor 24 came up from behind in the lane to the right, passed the ego and moved left into the ego's lane while still beside it. The actor's rear corner clipped the ego's front-right, which was counted as an at-fault front collision even though the ego hardly moved sideways.
